content.assumptions: Let A ⊆ B(Hₐₜ) be the fixed unital C*-algebra obtained by adjoining the chosen shell-link unitaries to the atomic representation of the CAR algebra C, and then taking the norm-closed unital *-algebra they generate. Density is computed in the norm topology on A; no CH assumption is made.
content.conclusion: There exists a norm-dense subset D ⊆ A with |D| = 𝔠, and every norm-dense subset E ⊆ A satisfies 𝔠 ≤ |E|. Thus dens(A) = 𝔠.
content.display_title: The norm density of A is exactly the continuum
content.lean_realization_notes: HasDensityCharacter contains an attained dense witness and a universal lower bound. This is not a statement about the strong-operator topology on a represented copy of A or an algebraic dimension.
content.natural_language_statement: The fixed CAR-based C*-algebra A has norm density character exactly 𝔠 = 2^ℵ₀.
content.one_sentence_role: Proves both existence of a dense set of the stated size and minimality of that size.

proof_steps.text: The full carrier A provides a dense witness of cardinality at most 𝔠.
Apply the lower bound for all norm-dense subsets of A to that witness to obtain exact cardinality 𝔠.
Apply the lower bound for all norm-dense subsets of A to an arbitrary dense subset for the universal minimality bound.

content.proof_summary: Combine the carrier-cardinality upper bound with the lower bound for every norm-dense subset.
